discovery_note: Queries discover public-news candidates. Topic terms alone do not establish eligibility. These queries are separate from the CT incident vocabulary and never feed Map or historical backfill.
include_rules: Accept a dated public-news update whose main subject matches at least one configured background topic. Evaluate only the supplied title and source excerpt; do not invent facts missing from them.

National governments, regulators, international organisations, industry, researchers and civilian protesters are eligible background subjects. A terrorism or criminal nexus is neither required nor desired for these records.

For cybersecurity, accept sector risk trends, aggregated incident trends, defensive developments and mitigation or detection updates. A report of a particular attack or criminal incident is an incident candidate, not a background record.

For AI guardrails, accept published changes, evaluations or ongoing testing explicitly linked to CBRN misuse safeguards, including nuclear or radiological safeguards. Retain only a high-level account of the evaluation and safeguards.

Assign only configured topic IDs and category Radiological/Nuclear. Preserve source attribution and uncertainty. These background records are archive-only and must not acquire incident coordinates or Map eligibility.
exclude_rules: Exclude reports whose main subject is a concrete terrorist attack, attack plot, criminal act, theft, smuggling, trafficking, seizure or terrorism/criminal investigation. Leave incident processing to the existing daily CT pipeline.

Exclude war, state military operations, nuclear weapons programmes, disarmament campaigns and anti-war or anti-weapons protests. Country names and civilian state authorities are not exclusions by themselves.
Exclude generic energy, AI or cybersecurity news without a clear nuclear/radiological link, except frontier-model CBRN safeguard evaluations explicitly requested as a background topic.
Exclude evergreen explainers, unsupported speculation and generic opinion pieces with no dated development. Do not infer eligibility from a nuclear term appearing incidentally.
Exclude operational instructions, unsafe prompt examples, exploit details or CBRN misuse methods. Background summaries describe the policy, safety measure or development at a high level.

topics.label: Regulation, national policy and licensing
topics.include: New or amended civilian nuclear/radiological laws, national policies, regulatory processes, licensing, approvals and requirements from facility construction through operation and decommissioning.
topics.exclude: Weapons policy, military programmes and generic political statements with no civilian industry regulatory development.
topics.query: (nuclear OR radiological OR radioactive) (regulation OR legislation OR "national policy" OR licensing OR "construction permit" OR "operating licence" OR "operating license")

topics.label: Emergency response training, drills and exercises
topics.include: National, multinational or international nuclear/radiological emergency-response training, drills or exercises, including NATO and CSTO activities when the activity is preparedness rather than warfare.
topics.exclude: Actual attacks or criminal events; military nuclear-weapon deployment exercises and anti-war reporting.
topics.query: (nuclear OR radiological OR "radiation emergency") ("emergency exercise" OR drill OR "response training" OR "emergency preparedness" OR NATO OR CSTO)

topics.label: Safety, security, cybersecurity and AI meetings
topics.include: Dated national or international meetings, conferences, workshops or consultations addressing nuclear/radiological safety, physical security, cybersecurity or industry AI applications.
topics.exclude: Meetings concerning warfare, weapons deployment or disarmament without a distinct civilian safety or security subject.
topics.query: (nuclear OR radiological) (safety OR security OR cybersecurity OR "artificial intelligence") (meeting OR conference OR workshop OR summit OR consultation)

topics.label: Industry supply chain and lifecycle
topics.include: Civilian cradle-to-grave supply-chain developments: uranium/thorium mining, transport, enrichment, fuel fabrication, nuclear facility siting/construction, operation, decommissioning, waste storage and spent-fuel or waste repatriation/return.
topics.exclude: Material theft, trafficking, smuggling or weapons supply chains; routine commodity prices with no reported industry lifecycle development.
topics.query: (nuclear OR uranium OR thorium OR radioactive) ("supply chain" OR mining OR transport OR enrichment OR siting OR decommissioning OR "waste storage" OR "spent fuel return" OR repatriation)

topics.label: Civilian anti-nuclear facility protests
topics.include: Environmental or local-resident opposition, demonstrations, sit-ins or blockades concerning construction or operation of a civilian nuclear/radiological facility or waste site.
topics.exclude: Anti-war, anti-weapons and disarmament protests; attacks, sabotage or criminal incidents whose main subject requires incident processing.
topics.query: ("nuclear plant" OR "nuclear facility" OR "radioactive waste" OR "radiological facility") (protest OR opposition OR blockade OR "sit-in") (environmental OR residents OR construction OR siting)

topics.label: New or updated IAEA guidance
topics.include: New or revised IAEA guidelines, standard operating procedures, safety/security standards, technical guides or related official publications with a reported release or update.
topics.exclude: Generic IAEA mentions, reprints of old guidance without an update and weapons/war reports unrelated to a civilian guidance release.
topics.query: (IAEA OR "International Atomic Energy Agency") ("new guide" OR guidelines OR "technical guide" OR "safety standards" OR "operating procedures") (released OR published OR updated OR revised)

topics.label: Facility cybersecurity defence, detection and trends
topics.include: Nuclear/radiological facility cybersecurity improvements, defence, monitoring, detection, audits, sector threat assessments and aggregated increases or changes in incident trends.
topics.exclude: A report centred on an individual cyberattack, criminal intrusion or sabotage; exploit instructions and generic cyber news with no nuclear/radiological facility link.
topics.query: ("nuclear facility" OR "nuclear plant" OR "radiological facility" OR "nuclear industry") (cybersecurity OR "cyber security") (defence OR defense OR detection OR assessment OR resilience OR "incident trends")

topics.label: AI applications in the nuclear/radiological industry
topics.include: Reported use, trials or deployment of AI in civilian nuclear/radiological design, construction, operation, maintenance, monitoring, inspection, safety, physical security, supply chains or waste management.
topics.exclude: Generic AI stories, weapons applications and detailed methods for harmful CBRN use.
topics.query: (nuclear OR radiological OR "radiation safety") ("artificial intelligence" OR "machine learning") (application OR deployment OR monitoring OR inspection OR maintenance OR design OR safety)

topics.label: Frontier AI CBRN safeguard evaluations and changes
topics.include: Published frontier-AI guardrail changes, safety evaluations, red-team findings or ongoing testing addressing CBRN-related prompts or misuse risks, including nuclear/radiological safeguards. Summarise only evaluation scope and safeguards.
topics.exclude: Unrelated AI safety debates, unsafe prompt examples, jailbreak instructions and CBRN misuse guidance.
topics.query: ("frontier AI" OR "AI model" OR "language model") (CBRN OR nuclear OR radiological) (guardrail OR safeguards OR evaluation OR "red teaming" OR "safety testing")

topics.label: Nuclear/radiological scientific and technological advances
topics.include: Dated scientific or technological advances such as nuclear-waste reuse/recycling, fusion developments, additive/3D manufacturing of nuclear components, or robotics for site inspection and physical security.
topics.exclude: Generic science without a nuclear/radiological industry link, routine clinical stories and operational weapons or misuse instructions.
topics.query: (nuclear OR radiological OR fusion OR "radioactive waste") (innovation OR breakthrough OR recycling OR "waste reuse" OR "3D printing" OR "additive manufacturing" OR robotics)
